{"notes": "VISIT 4 (left 6:30). Still don't know who placed what. Ratings rest on what I heard, the picture, and private updates.

Picture: the whole fish outline is dark and connected (start run, top body, belly, lower fin, upper fin, tail loops). The stray line up toward (22,4.5) is no longer visible. Pale leftovers remain only at the junction (~22.5-24, 8.5-12) and as a curl inside the tail loop (~24-28.5, 10.5-12.5). They look disconnected and harmless to the outline. I don't know who removed the stray line. Hana said she was clearing it, but I didn't see it.

Sofia: Her 6:00 status matched the picture, including the pale bits being harmless. She called for hands off the junction and a watch for bumps. Consistently accurate and the team's coordinator. Rating stays high on collaboration and leadership, and strong on impact.

Omar: His private account (belly to junction, one bridging domino on the upper fin) matches what he said at 5:15 and the dark upper fin. He chose not to add more in the crowded junction, which is sound judgment. Still the strongest on impact and execution. I'm crediting the bridge on his word plus the picture, not on seeing it.

Hana: Her messages are reassuring, but she claims credit for the plan, sketch and coordination, and says the fish is built. Only the early planning is something I saw myself. Her totals also differ from Omar's (165 vs 170). Still no visible fix on the fin. Keeping impact and leadership low-mid. Ask her in the review what she physically built, and who cleared the stray line.

Jack: Silent again, with no visible contribution. Collaboration and impact stay low. Ask him in the review what he built, and don't assume he did nothing."}
